environment: Desktop Chromium, 390x844 touch emulation, real Creator 3.8.8 frames at 1x. Not a physical mobile device or human playtest.
timing: Real projected car taps follow recorded simulation-time deadlines. Late inputs are not batched: each next tap waits at least one cadence after the previous acceptance was observed. Acceptance times and queue peaks are RAF-sampled, not exact simulation-tick replay.
